name: blueprint/market-signals
description: Keyless prediction-market odds into a signal: fetch public Polymarket data, store the odds history, alert on threshold crossings
ingredients: guardedFetch over the public Polymarket API (keyless)
recipe: fetch the market's current odds -> append the history record -> compare against the stored target -> on crossing: notify once and record the alert
pitfalls: probe the endpoint first - market APIs drift
odds are prices, not truth - the receipt records the source and time
warn-once needs its own record or every poll re-fires
one market per slug keeps the scans cheap
